title: Suspected Lymphoma - Diagnostic Workup & Staging Pathway
organization: National Cancer Grid (India) / NCG-Heme Working Group
source: NCG Guidelines - Lymphoma Workup Flowchart with Immunophenotyping & Validated Prognostic Indices
description: Evidence-based clinical decision pathway guiding initial evaluation, peripheral blood flow cytometry vs. tissue biopsy triage, staging imaging (PET-CT vs CECT), bone marrow biopsy indications, CNS staging, pre-treatment viral prophylaxis (HBV, HCV, HIV), TLS metabolic prophylaxis, and validated prognostic scoring (aaIPI, IPI, FLIPI, MIPI, CLL-IPI, IPS, MALT-IPI, PIT).
author: NCG-Heme Working Group

findings.label: Peripheral smear / lymphocytosis
findings.help: Step 4 critical branch point: presence of abnormal circulating lymphocytes or absolute lymphocytosis (>5 x 10^9/L).

findings.label: Suspected / confirmed subtype
findings.help: Histopathological or flow-cytometric diagnosis per WHO / NCG classification.

findings.label: CLL therapy indication status
findings.help: Step 7 imaging triage for CLL: asymptomatic observation vs. progressive disease / cytopenias requiring therapy.

findings.label: Anatomical stage / clinical extent
findings.help: Validated anatomical extent (Ann Arbor stage) from clinical assessment or imaging.

values.label: MF extensive / nodular plaques / Sézary cells

findings.label: CNS high-risk features
findings.help: High-risk extranodal involvement (testicular, parameningeal, breast, renal, adrenal, >2 extranodal sites with high LDH, blastoid MCL).

values.label: Standard risk / no high-risk CNS features

findings.label: Planned regimen & organ safety
findings.help: Planned systemic therapy requiring baseline organ assessment (anthracycline cardiotoxicity or high-dose MTX renal monitoring).

values.label: High-dose Methotrexate planned (age >40 or renal risk)
Other standard therapy / low cardiac risk

findings.label: Hepatitis B serology (HBsAg / HBcAb)
findings.help: Screening before B-cell depleting (anti-CD20) or immunosuppressive therapy to prevent fatal HBV reactivation.

findings.label: Hepatitis C serology (Anti-HCV)
findings.help: Screening before systemic therapy. If positive, quantitative HCV RNA is required with hepatologist referral.

findings.label: HIV screening serology
findings.help: Step 3 viral marker: if positive, check CD4 count, viral load, initiate OI prophylaxis, and coordinate non-myelosuppressive ART.

findings.label: Tumor lysis syndrome (TLS) metabolic risk
findings.help: Metabolic panel screening (Ca, Phos, Uric acid, LDH) to detect hyperuricemia and high TLS risk before therapy.

values.label: High TLS risk (bulky disease, elevated uric acid / LDH)

findings.label: Double-hit (DHL) FISH panel (MYC/BCL2)
findings.help: Reflex cytogenetic testing in GCB-DLBCL to screen for MYC and BCL-2 rearrangements.

findings.label: Age group (IPI / aaIPI / FLIPI / MIPI stratification)
findings.help: Age factor for prognostic scoring: Age <= 60 uses aaIPI (max score 3); Age > 60 uses standard IPI/FLIPI; Age >= 70 confers adverse risk in MIPI and MALT-IPI.

findings.label: ECOG performance status
findings.help: Performance status at presentation (ECOG >= 2 is an adverse prognostic factor in IPI, aaIPI, MIPI, and PIT).

findings.label: Serum LDH (Lactate Dehydrogenase)
findings.help: Serum LDH compared to upper limit of normal (ULN). Elevated LDH indicates high tumor proliferation and is an adverse factor across all indices.

findings.label: Extranodal involvement sites
findings.help: Number of involved extranodal anatomical sites (> 1 extranodal site is an adverse factor in standard IPI).

findings.label: Hemoglobin level
findings.help: Adverse anemia threshold: Hb < 12 g/dL in FLIPI; Hb < 10.5 g/dL in IPS for Hodgkin Lymphoma.

findings.label: White blood cell count (WBC)
findings.help: Elevated leucocyte count: WBC >= 10 x 10^9/L in MIPI; WBC >= 15 x 10^9/L in IPS.

findings.label: Serum albumin
findings.help: Serum albumin < 4.0 g/dL is an adverse factor in IPS for Hodgkin Lymphoma.

findings.label: Beta-2 microglobulin (B2M)
findings.help: Elevated B2M (> 3.5 mg/L in CLL-IPI; > ULN in FLIPI-2) indicates high tumor burden.

findings.label: TP53 mutation / 17p deletion
findings.help: TP53 disruption (17p deletion or mutation) confers 4 points in CLL-IPI and predicts chemotherapy refractoriness.

values.label: TP53 mutated or 17p deletion present (high risk)

findings.label: IGHV somatic mutation status
findings.help: Unmutated IGHV (>=98% homology to germline) confers 2 points in CLL-IPI.

findings.label: Bone marrow biopsy involvement
findings.help: Bone marrow infiltration confirmed on aspirate/trephine (adverse factor in FLIPI-2 and PIT).

findings.label: Number of involved nodal sites
findings.help: > 4 nodal anatomical areas involved confers 1 adverse point in FLIPI.

functions.name: aaIPI
functions.label: Age-adjusted IPI (aaIPI)
functions.description: Age-adjusted International Prognostic Index for DLBCL in patients age <= 60 years. Sums Stage III-IV (1 pt), elevated LDH (1 pt), and ECOG >= 2 (1 pt). Max score: 3.

functions.name: IPI
functions.label: International Prognostic Index (IPI)
functions.description: Standard IPI for DLBCL (all ages). Sums Age > 60 (1 pt), Stage III-IV (1 pt), elevated LDH (1 pt), ECOG >= 2 (1 pt), Extranodal > 1 site (1 pt). Max: 5.

functions.name: FLIPI
functions.label: Follicular Lymphoma International Prognostic Index (FLIPI)
functions.description: Prognostic index for Follicular Lymphoma. Sums Age > 60 (1 pt), Stage III-IV (1 pt), Hb < 12 g/dL (1 pt), Nodal sites > 4 (1 pt), LDH > ULN (1 pt). Max: 5.

functions.name: CLLIPI
functions.label: CLL International Prognostic Index (CLL-IPI)
functions.description: Prognostic scoring for CLL: TP53 del/mut (4 pts), IGHV unmutated (2 pts), B2M > 3.5 mg/L (2 pts), Stage III-IV (1 pt), Age > 65 (1 pt). Max: 10.

functions.name: MIPI
functions.label: MCL International Prognostic Index (MIPI)
functions.description: Simplified MIPI for Mantle Cell Lymphoma. Evaluates Age, ECOG, LDH, and WBC count. Max: 11.

functions.name: IPS
functions.label: International Prognostic Score (IPS)
functions.description: IPS for Hodgkin Lymphoma: Albumin < 4 (1 pt), Hb < 10.5 (1 pt), Stage IV (1 pt), Age >= 45 (1 pt), WBC >= 15 (1 pt). Max: 5.

functions.name: MALT_IPI
functions.label: MALT-IPI
functions.description: Marginal Zone / MALT International Prognostic Index. Sums Age >= 70 (1 pt), Stage III-IV (1 pt), LDH > ULN (1 pt). Max: 3.

functions.name: PIT
functions.label: Prognostic Index for PTCL (PIT)
functions.description: Prognostic scoring for Peripheral T-Cell Lymphoma. Age > 60 (1 pt), ECOG >= 2 (1 pt), LDH > ULN (1 pt), Bone marrow involvement (1 pt). Max: 4.

outcomes.label: Needs clinician review (Safety gate)
outcomes.rationale: Critical diagnostic or staging inputs are missing, unrecorded, or derived from unverified free-text. A clinician must review before ordering invasive biopsies or treatment.

outcomes.label: HBV Reactivation Prophylaxis Protocol
outcomes.rationale: HBsAg or HBcAb-IgG positivity carries a high risk of lethal Hepatitis B reactivation under anti-CD20 (rituximab) or immunosuppressive chemotherapy. Quantitative HBV DNA and prophylactic entecavir or tenofovir are mandatory.

regimens.name: Quantitative HBV DNA PCR test
Initiate prophylactic antiviral therapy (Entecavir 0.5 mg daily or Tenofovir)
Continue antiviral prophylaxis during and for at least 12 months post-chemotherapy
LFT monitoring every 4-6 weeks

outcomes.label: HCV Management: Quantitative HCV RNA + Hepatology Referral
outcomes.rationale: Step 3: Anti-HCV positive patients require quantitative HCV RNA testing. If detectable, urgent referral to a gastroenterologist/hepatologist prior to systemic chemo is mandatory to coordinate direct-acting antiviral (DAA) therapy.

regimens.name: Quantitative HCV RNA by RT-PCR
Gastroenterology / Hepatology referral before systemic therapy
Coordinate Direct-Acting Antiviral (DAA) therapy

outcomes.label: HIV Lymphoma Protocol: CD4/Viral Load + ART Coordination
outcomes.rationale: Step 3: In HIV-positive patients, evaluate CD4 count and HIV viral load, initiate opportunistic infection (OI) prophylaxis per CD4 count, and coordinate ART avoiding myelosuppressive drugs (e.g. avoid Zidovudine).

regimens.name: CD4 cell count and HIV-1 RNA viral load
Opportunistic infection (OI) assessment and prophylaxis (PJP, MAC, Fungal)
Coordinate with HIV specialist; avoid myelosuppressive antiretroviral agents

outcomes.label: Tumor Lysis Syndrome (TLS) Metabolic Prophylaxis
outcomes.rationale: Step 3: Metabolic screening identifies high-risk TLS (elevated uric acid, high LDH, bulky disease). Mandatory vigorous IV hydration, urine output monitoring, and Rasburicase or Allopurinol prophylaxis.

regimens.name: Aggressive intravenous hydration (2.5-3 L/m2/day) with strict I/O monitoring
Rasburicase (0.2 mg/kg IV) for hyperuricemia or Allopurinol for moderate risk
Serum electrolytes, Ca, Phos, Uric acid, Creatinine, LDH Q6-12h

outcomes.label: Double-Hit Lymphoma (DHL): High-Grade B-Cell Protocol
outcomes.rationale: Step 8: GCB-DLBCL harboring concurrent MYC and BCL-2 rearrangements has poor outcomes with standard R-CHOP. Dose-adjusted EPOCH-R (DA-EPOCH-R) and CNS prophylaxis are recommended.

regimens.name: Dose-adjusted EPOCH-R (DA-EPOCH-R) regimen
Diagnostic LP and CNS-directed prophylaxis (IT methotrexate / cytarabine)
Evaluate for autologous or allogeneic stem cell transplantation in CR1

outcomes.label: Peripheral Blood Flow Cytometry (Avoid initial nodal biopsy)
outcomes.rationale: Step 4 & 5: Abnormal lymphocytosis on smear enables rapid peripheral blood immunophenotyping. Lymph node biopsy is avoided (unless FL or Richter transformation suspected). Bone marrow exam is NOT required if flow confirms diagnosis.

regimens.name: Flow cytometry CLPD panel (CD5, CD10, CD19, CD20, CD23, CD22, FMC7, CD200, Cyclin D1)
Subtype differentiation (CLL vs MCL vs FL vs SMZL vs HCL vs T/NK-CLPD)
Omit initial lymph node biopsy and routine bone marrow examination

outcomes.label: Tissue Excision Biopsy + Immunohistochemistry (IHC)
outcomes.rationale: Step 6: In the absence of peripheral lymphocytosis, primary diagnosis requires histopathological examination. Excision biopsy of the largest accessible lymph node is preferred over core needle.

regimens.name: Excision biopsy of largest accessible lymph node (preferred over FNA/core)
Comprehensive lymphoma IHC panel (B-cell, T-cell, proliferation markers)
Image-guided core needle biopsy (USG/CT) if nodes are deep/internal or surgery contraindicated

outcomes.label: Staging: Whole-body PET-CT + Bone Marrow Examination
outcomes.rationale: Step 7 & 8: For low-grade lymphomas (FL, MZL, MCL, Burkitt, PTCL), whole-body 18F-FDG PET-CT is standard staging, AND bone marrow aspiration + trephine biopsy is mandatory because marrow involvement dictates stage and prognosis.

regimens.name: Whole-body 18F-FDG PET-CT (skull base to mid-thigh)
Bone marrow aspiration + imprint + trephine biopsy
Flow cytometry and cytogenetics on bone marrow aspirate

outcomes.label: Staging: PET-CT alone (Bone Marrow NOT required)
outcomes.rationale: Step 8: In Stage I-II DLBCL and Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma staged with high-quality PET-CT, PET-CT has exceptional negative predictive value for marrow disease. Routine bone marrow biopsy can be safely omitted.

regimens.name: Whole-body 18F-FDG PET-CT
Omit routine bone marrow biopsy (PET-CT sufficient)
Calculate disease-specific prognostic index (aaIPI / IPI / IPS)

outcomes.label: CLL Staging: CXR PA view + Abdominal USG (Minimal Staging)
outcomes.rationale: Step 7: For asymptomatic CLL without therapy indication, avoid unnecessary radiation from CT and invasive bone marrow biopsy. Baseline CXR and abdominal ultrasonography are sufficient.

regimens.name: CXR PA view + Ultrasound abdomen and pelvis
Omit CT chest/abdomen/pelvis and omit bone marrow biopsy
Active clinical and haematological surveillance (every 3-6 months)

outcomes.label: CLL Pre-Therapy Workup: CECT + Bone Marrow + FISH Panel
outcomes.rationale: Step 7 & 8: When CLL requires systemic treatment: CECT chest/abdomen/pelvis is indicated, bone marrow biopsy evaluates cytopenias, and CLL FISH panel (17p deletion, TP53, IgVH mutation status) is mandatory.

regimens.name: CECT chest + abdomen + pelvis
Bone marrow aspirate & trephine biopsy (for cytopenias / reserve assessment)
CLL FISH panel (del 17p, 11q, 13q, +12) + TP53 mutation + IgVH status
Calculate CLL-IPI prognostic score

outcomes.label: MZL Staging: Diagnostic CECT + SPEP + Subtype Genetics
outcomes.rationale: Step 7 & 8: In Marginal Zone Lymphoma (all subtypes), CECT chest/abdomen/pelvis is preferred. Serum Protein Electrophoresis (SPEP) evaluates paraproteinemia, and t(11;18) FISH in gastric MALT predicts anti-H. pylori resistance.

regimens.name: CECT chest + abdomen + pelvis
Serum Protein Electrophoresis (SPEP) for paraprotein / immunoglobulin spike
Bone marrow aspirate and trephine biopsy
t(11;18) translocation FISH if gastric MALT (predicts H. pylori resistance)

outcomes.label: High-Risk CNS Staging (LP with CSF flow) + 2D-ECHO
outcomes.rationale: Step 8: For DLBCL with high-risk extranodal involvement (testicular, parameningeal, renal/adrenal) or blastoid MCL: diagnostic lumbar puncture with CSF morphology and flow cytometry is mandatory. 2D-ECHO is required prior to anthracyclines.

regimens.name: Diagnostic Lumbar Puncture: CSF cytology + flow cytometry
Brain MRI with contrast (if neurological symptoms or PCNSL suspected)
2D-Echocardiography (LVEF assessment) prior to anthracycline therapy
Plan CNS-directed prophylaxis (intrathecal MTX or systemic high-dose MTX)

outcomes.label: Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma: Skin Biopsy + Stage-Directed Imaging
outcomes.rationale: Step 6 & 7: Skin biopsy is mandatory for MF/Sézary subtype confirmation. Early thin-plaque disease requires clinical staging only. Extensive skin, tumour, or Sézary cells in peripheral blood require CECT chest/abdomen/pelvis.

regimens.name: Skin biopsy (punch or incisional, mandatory for histopathology + TCR clonality)
Clinical skin staging (mSWAT score for early plaque disease)
CECT chest + abdomen + pelvis if nodular, extensive skin disease, or Sézary cells
Peripheral blood smear review for cerebriform Sézary cells

outcomes.label: High-Dose MTX Protocol: Mandatory DTPA-GFR Clearance
outcomes.rationale: Step 8: High-dose Methotrexate requires accurate baseline renal glomerular clearance. In patients aged > 40 or with diabetic/hypertensive/borderline eGFR, 99mTc-DTPA GFR is mandatory before infusion.

regimens.name: 99mTc-DTPA GFR clearance test (mandatory before high-dose MTX if age > 40)
Hydration and urine alkalinization protocol (target urinary pH >= 7.0)
Leucovorin rescue planning and methotrexate serum drug level monitoring

rules.label: Hepatitis B positive requiring antiviral prophylaxis
Hepatitis C positive requiring HCV RNA and hepatology referral
HIV positive requiring viral load, CD4 count, and OI prophylaxis
High metabolic risk requiring Tumor Lysis Syndrome prophylaxis
DLBCL or MCL with CNS high-risk anatomical features
High-dose Methotrexate planned requiring DTPA-GFR renal clearance
Limited-stage DLBCL or Hodgkin Lymphoma on PET-CT (omit marrow)
Low-grade lymphomas, MCL, Burkitt, PTCL (PET-CT + BM required)
Advanced DLBCL (Age <= 60) with high aaIPI score (>= 2)

testCases.name: Circulating lymphocytosis on smear
testCases.description: 64M with absolute lymphocyte count 28 x 10^9/L, smudge cells on smear. Routes directly to peripheral blood flow cytometry.

testCases.name: Isolated cervical lymphadenopathy (no lymphocytosis)
testCases.description: 45F presenting with 3.5 cm painless neck mass, normal CBC and smear. Routes to tissue excision biopsy + IHC.

testCases.name: Asymptomatic CLL without treatment indication
testCases.description: 71M with known CLL, normal hemoglobin and platelets, asymptomatic. Undergoes baseline CXR + abdominal USG; omits CT and bone marrow biopsy.

testCases.name: CLL with progressive cytopenias requiring therapy
testCases.description: 68F with progressive fatigue, Hb 9.2 g/dL, massive splenomegaly. Needs CECT staging, bone marrow biopsy, and CLL FISH panel (17p/TP53/IgVH).

testCases.name: Stage I DLBCL staged with PET-CT (omit marrow)
testCases.description: 52M with localized axillary DLBCL. PET-CT confirms Stage I. Routine bone marrow biopsy is safely omitted.

testCases.name: Follicular Lymphoma staging (PET-CT + bone marrow mandatory)
testCases.description: 59F with biopsy-proven Follicular Lymphoma Grade 2. Requires both PET-CT and bone marrow biopsy for complete staging.

testCases.name: Marginal Zone Lymphoma staging (CECT + SPEP)
testCases.description: 63M with gastric MALT lymphoma. Staged with CECT chest/abdomen/pelvis, SPEP, and t(11;18) translocation testing.

testCases.name: DLBCL with testicular involvement (high-risk CNS staging + LP)
testCases.description: 56M with primary testicular DLBCL. Mandatory diagnostic LP with CSF flow cytometry and 2D-ECHO before anthracyclines.

testCases.name: HBsAg-positive patient scheduled for anti-CD20 therapy
testCases.description: 60F with lymphoma and positive HBsAg. Triggers quantitative HBV DNA and antiviral prophylaxis prior to rituximab.

testCases.name: Referral note with unparsed text (Safety provenance gate)
testCases.description: External referral document has unparsed smear text. Safety gate enforces clinician review instead of automatic processing.

testCases.name: Cutaneous T-cell Lymphoma / Mycosis Fungoides
testCases.description: 48M presenting with multiple pruritic erythematous skin plaques. Requires skin biopsy for confirmation and clinical mSWAT staging.

testCases.name: Anti-HCV positive patient requiring HCV RNA & hepatology referral
testCases.description: 54M presenting with DLBCL and reactive Anti-HCV serology. Triggers quantitative HCV RNA PCR and hepatologist consultation prior to chemotherapy.

testCases.name: HIV-associated lymphoma requiring multidisciplinary ART management
testCases.description: 39M with DLBCL and newly diagnosed HIV. Evaluates CD4 count, viral load, opportunistic infection prophylaxis, avoiding zidovudine.

testCases.name: High metabolic risk patient requiring Tumor Lysis Syndrome prophylaxis
testCases.description: 46M with high-grade lymphoma, uric acid 9.8 mg/dL, and elevated LDH. Prioritizes aggressive hydration and rasburicase.

testCases.name: Double-Hit Lymphoma confirmed on FISH (DA-EPOCH-R)
testCases.description: 61F with GCB-DLBCL and confirmed MYC + BCL2 translocations on FISH. Pathways to dose-adjusted EPOCH-R and CNS evaluation.

testCases.name: High-dose Methotrexate planned in older adult requiring DTPA-GFR
testCases.description: 65M with primary CNS lymphoma planned for high-dose methotrexate. Triggers mandatory 99mTc-DTPA GFR clearance before infusion.

testCases.name: Advanced DLBCL in 48M with High aaIPI (Score 2: LDH + Stage IV)
testCases.description: 48M presenting with Ann Arbor Stage IV DLBCL, elevated serum LDH, and ECOG 0-1. Fires Rule 18 with embedded aaIPI score condition (score >= 2).

customDefinitions.name: Requires_HCV_RNA
customDefinitions.comment: HCV RNA confirmation trigger: mandatory before systemic therapy if Anti-HCV is reactive

customDefinitions.name: Requires_HIV_Staging
customDefinitions.comment: HIV multidisciplinary staging trigger: mandatory CD4, viral load, and OI prophylaxis if HIV reactive

customDefinitions.name: Requires_DoubleHit_FISH
customDefinitions.comment: Double-Hit Lymphoma triage: verifies GCB-DLBCL with MYC and BCL2/6 rearrangements

customDefinitions.name: Requires_DTPA_GFR
customDefinitions.comment: Renal clearance trigger: mandatory 99mTc-DTPA GFR if high-dose methotrexate is planned and age > 40

customDefinitions.name: Requires_TLS_Prophylaxis
customDefinitions.comment: Tumor Lysis Syndrome prophylaxis trigger: indicates aggressive IV hydration and rasburicase/allopurinol
